Change has been successfully merged
Since we already have `gpuName` as constructor parameter do we really need `inventoryPath` as well? Can't constructor create it from `gpuName`?

Good point — now that inventoryPrefix lives in NvidiaUtils.hpp, the ctor can build the path from gpuName internally. 

Updated MemoryDevice, ClockFrequencyMetric, ClockSpeedControl and PowerControl to drop the inventoryPath parameter and build the path from the shared constant.
LGTM
Why don't we use `sdbusplus::object_path()` here?

I don't think this change should have been made in this commit. 
I imagine there could be a future patch to change all path strings to `sdbusplus::object_path()`.
Sure!
Should we use `sdbusplus::object_path()` here as well?
Acknowledged
